title: Missing kernel check for free variables in `opaque` declarations
summary: Just as for definitions and theorems, an `opaque` declaration's value must not contain fvars. This check was missing in the kernel, letting a malicious metaprogram prove False. Comparator would have caught this (its export format cannot express fvars), as would nanoda. v4.32.0 is vulnerable; v4.32.1 and v4.33.0+ have the fix.
